text:
Type: drop-leaf dining table
Use: dining, small meals, extra surface when needed; kitchen, small dining room, studio apartment
Style: Scandinavian, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: bamboo veneer top and folding leaves, white painted frame
Colors: warm honey bamboo, white
Shape: rectangular top with two hinged drop leaves, slim white apron, four slender splayed legs, folds narrow against a wall, light and compact
Feel: fresh, bright, practical, airy
Goes with: white or light wood chairs, pale walls, natural textures; Scandinavian kitchens or compact modern dining nooks
